                                     BUILDINGS BULLETIN 2020-003
                                                           Zoning


    Supersedes in         Departmental Memorandum dated May 18, 1978 from Acting Commissioner Irving E.
            Part:         Minkin, P.E. to Borough Superintendents

             Issuer:      Gus Sirakis, P.E.
                          First Deputy Commissioner

    Issuance Date:        March 2, 2020

          Purpose:        This document clarifies that a newly formed zoning lot may not consist of parts of tax lots.

          Related         ZR 12-10
      Code/Zoning            Definition of
       Section(s):           “Zoning
                             Lot”

        Subject(s):       Zoning Lots


    Departmental Memorandum dated May 18, 1978 from Acting Commissioner Irving E. Minkin, P.E. to Borough
    Superintendents is superseded in part to the extent that a zoning lot may not consist of parts of tax lots unless
    a permit has been issued in reliance on such zoning lot prior to the date of issuance of this bulletin.
